Decision support system is especially conducts with computing elements which mainly depicts successful report of a company. This system allow to the application of technological development and software application to maintain ethical ways of business practices. The major types of DSS are document driven DSS, model driven DSS, communication driven

  • DSS, data driven DSS and knowledge driven DSS. These types are mainly impact on business practices which finally creates systematic effect on advance production.
  • Graphical interfaces and artificial intelligence are major aspects in this decision making procedure.
  • In the following part of the study, the challenges of using a decision support system in a business has been illustrated in an extensive manner.

The subject of a certificate may include a wildcard in the certificate name, indicating that the certificate is good for subdomains as well.

The wildcard is designated by an asterisk character. For example, a wildcard certificate issued to *.certmike.com would be valid for all of the following domains:

1. Guud ahaan Xaaladda Domain-ka (Sawirka 1)

Bogga "Domains" ee akoonka Cloudflare wuxuu muujinayaa in domain-ka iecms.gov.so uu ku jiro "Free plan", waxaana geliyay tiir gaar ah oo la yidhaahdo "Status" oo qeexaya xaaladda hadda ee domain-ku. Qiimaha ku qoran tiirkan waa: "⚠ Moved" (u wareejin). Tirooyinka "Security Insights" iyo "Unique visitors" waxay muujinayaan "No data", taasoo tilmaamaysa in aan la heli karin xog dhaqameed oo ku saabsan booqashada goobta, sababtoo ah booggaga lama gaari karo.

2. Diiwaanada DNS-ka (Sawirka 2)

Bogga "DNS records for iecms.gov.so" wuxuu muujinayaa in 10 diiwaan oo nooca "A" ah la dhisay, dhammaantoodna ay leeyihiin xaalad "Proxied" (Cloudflare orange cloud) iyo TTL "Auto". Diiwaanadan waxaa ka mid ah: ago, cid, correctional, courts, docs, efilingago, efilingcourts, eservices, lawyers, iyo reports — dhammaantoodna ay ku xigo iecms.gov.so. Waxaa kaloo lagu daray in bogga "Recommendations" uu si toos ah u soo bandhigo digniin sheegaysa in 'Visitors cannot reach www.iecms.gov.so' iyo 'Visitors cannot reach iecms.gov.so', taasoo caddaynaysa in root domain-ka (iecms.gov.so) uusan lahayn diiwaan A ama CNAME oo toos u xiran, sidaas darteedna aan la gaari karin.

3. Gunaanad

Sawirrada labadan waxay muujinayaan in dhibaatadu aysan ka imaan diiwaanada DNS-ka ee hoosaadyada (sub-domains), maadaama ay dhammaantood si sax ah loo dhisay oo ay yihiin 10 diiwaan oo shaqeynaya. Dhibaatadu waxay ka timaadaa heerka guud ee domain-ka (root domain: iecms.gov.so), kaas oo akoonka Cloudflare uu ku calaamadiyay xaalad "Moved", iyo maqnaanshaha diiwaan A/CNAME oo loogu talagalay www iyo bogga hoyga (root). Taasi waxay u baahan tahay in la xaqiijiyo xaaladda diiwaangelinta domain-ka ee heer qaran (.SO) ama in la dib-u-dejiyo (reconfigure) diiwaanka root-ka iyo www si loo soo celiyo gelitaanka goobta.

Fiiro gaar ah: Warbixintani waxay ku salaysan tahay dib-u-eegis muuqaal ah (visual review) oo lagu sameeyay laba sawir oo laga soo qaaday interface-ka Cloudflare, mana aha baaritaan farsamo oo dheeraad ah oo lagu sameeyay adeegyada network-ka (sida ping, traceroute, ama WHOIS).
